Pin

Sensor Immunity: K'kayeh Dreambeasts cannot be detected by life-form scanning sensors.

Surface Camouflage: K'kayeh Dreambeasts receive a +5 bonus on Stealth checks while in a desert environment.

Special Qualities: Sensor Immunity, Surface Camouflage

Immune: Mind-Affecting effects

Senses: Darkvision, Perception +10

system.description:
See also: Beasts, Creating New Beasts

Beasts have an Intelligence of 1 or 2. They roll their other five Ability Scores as normal. Beasts that show above average cunning usually have a good Wisdom score.

Beasts increase only one Ability Score by one point every fourth level (instead of increasing two scores by one point each). However, they gain Feats normally as they advance in level. A beast that gains an Intelligence of 3 or higher as a result of an ability increase is eligible to Multiclass.

Beasts do not gain Talents or starting Feats, do not add their Beast Level to their Defenses, and do not gain Force Points or Destiny Points.

Examples of Beasts in Star Wars

Acklay, Dewback, Nexu, Rancor, Reek, Tauntaun, Wampa.

Game Rule Information

Beasts have the following game statistics:

Beast Leveling Statistics

LEVEL

BASE ATTACK BONUS LEVEL BASE ATTACK BONUS
1st +0 11th +8
2nd +1 12th +9
3rd +2 13th +9
4th +3 14th +10
5th +3 15th +11
6th +4 16th +12
7th +5 17th +12
8th +6 18th +13
9th +6 19th +14
10th +7 20th +15

Hit Points

At each level, Beasts gain a number of Hit Points equal to 1d8 + their Constitution modifier.

Force Points

Beasts do not gain Force Points.

Class Skills

At 1st level, Beasts become Trained in a number of Skills equal to 1 + their Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). They can select their Trained Skills from the below list:

  • Acrobatics
  • Climb
  • Endurance
  • Initiative
  • Jump
  • Perception
  • Stealth
  • Survival
  • Swim

Class Features

Beasts gain special features unique to themselves. See Creature Generator.

Multiclassing

A Beast with an Intelligence of 3 or higher can Multiclass into any Heroic Class. Beasts with an Intelligence of 1 or 2 cannot Multiclass.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats

You are Force-sensitive, allowing you to call on The Force and learn to draw on its powers.

Prerequisite: Cannot be a Droid

Effect: You can make Use the Force checks, and Use the Force is considered a Class Skill for you. In addition, whenever you gain a Talent, you have the option of selecting a Force Talent instead. You must meet the prerequisites of the Force Talent to select it.

Normal: You can't make Use the Force checks or select Force Talents unless you have the Force Sensitivity Feat.

See also: Feats

You learn one or more Force Powers.

Prerequisites: Force Sensitivity, Trained in Use the Force.

Effect: You add to your Force Power Suite a number of Force Powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier (Minimum 1). You can add the same Force Power more than once.

Special: You can take this Feat more than once. Each time you take this Feat, you add to your Force Power Suite a number of new Force Powers equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier.

Additional Force Training Effects

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

Combined Feat (Improved Disarm): When you use the Force Disarm Force Power, you gain the +5 bonus from Improved Disarm on your Use the Force check as though you were making an attack roll.

prerequisite.text: Force Sensitivity feat, and Trained in Use the Force

system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats, Grappling 101

You are skilled at immobilizing Grappled foes.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: If you succeed on a Grappling attack and your opponent fails the opposed Grapple check, your opponent is automatically Pinned until the start of your next turn. A Pinned creature can't move or take any Actions while Pinned, and it loses its Dexterity bonus (if any) to Reflex Defense.

Special: You cannot use the Pin and Trip Feats during the same round. You can use the Pin and Crush Feats in the same round, however.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats

You are considered Trained in a new Skill.

Effect: Choose one Untrained Skill from your list of Class Skills. You become Trained in that Skill.

Special: This Feat may be selected multiple times. Each time you take this Feat, it applies to a different Class Skill.

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook

See also: Feats

You are considered Trained in a new Skill.

Effect: Choose one Untrained Skill from your list of Class Skills. You become Trained in that Skill.

Special: This Feat may be selected multiple times. Each time you take this Feat, it applies to a different Class Skill.

See also: Force Powers

You blast an enemy with deadly arcs of Force energy.

[Dark Side]

Time: Standard Action

Targets: One target in line of sight and within 6 squares of user.

Make a Use the Force check. Make one roll and compare the result to the target's Reflex Defense. If your Use the Force check equals or exceeds the target’s Reflex Defense, the target takes 8d6 points of Force damage and moves -1 step along the Condition Track. Otherwise, the target takes half damage and does not move along the Condition Track.

Special: You can spend a Force Point to move a target an additional -1 step along the Condition Track when you successfully hit it with Force Lightning.
